summary_zh: Nextcloud服务器端项目，用于自建数据存储与协作平台：在自选服务器上存储文件、联系人和日历，在设备间同步，并向他人分享或协作；可通过数百个应用扩展，并提供加密、漏洞赏金和双因素认证等安全机制。
audience_zh: 适合希望在自选服务器上存放并同步文件、日历和联系人，需要与他人分享协作，或为家庭、组织搭建私有云的个人与团队；也适合关注企业、公共部门或教育场景方案的用户及贡献者。

evidence.quote: * 📁 **Access your Data** You can store your files, contacts, calendars, and more on a server of your choosing.
* 🔄 **Sync your Data** You keep your files, contacts, calendars, and more synchronized amongst your devices.
* 🙌 **Share your Data** …by giving others access to the stuff you want them to see or to collaborate with.

Do you want to learn more about how you can use Nextcloud to access, share, and protect your files, calendars, contacts, communication & more at home and in your organization? [**Learn about all our Features**](https://nextcloud.com/athome/).
